name: Bad Company
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid close association with ungodly, foolish, or angry individuals, as such company can lead to spiritual ruin and shame. The Psalms emphasize the blessedness of not walking in the counsel of the wicked or sitting with vain and dissembling people. Proverbs further instruct to seek the company of the wise and to depart from those lacking knowledge or prone to anger, highlighting that companionship with fools or riotous men results in destruction and dishonor. These verses collectively underscore the importance of choosing one's companions carefully to maintain wisdom, holiness, and honor before God.
